name: sheetscale
description: SheetScale - private, local-only PDF markup and measurement app

scripts.build: npm run assets && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run fixtures && node scripts/make-demo-plan.mjs && playwright test
scripts.test:perf: npm run build && node scripts/make-big-fixtures.mjs && playwright test -c playwright.perf.config.ts
scripts.test:desktop: cd desktop && npm run dist:linux && cd .. && playwright test -c playwright.desktop.config.ts
